csat.note: CSAT is a 1-5 score distribution plus the sealed reason enum. Every figure names its cohort and window and no target is rendered beside it (invariant 20). Below the k >= 10 floor only the count survives (files/06 §8).

nps.note: NPS on the 0-10 scale, with the promoter/passive/detractor counts that produced it. Below the k >= 10 floor only the count survives (files/08 §0c F9).

pulse.note: Quarterly clinician pulse, 1-5. Clinicians appear as counts only (invariant 6). Below the k >= 10 floor only the count survives.

dimensions.reason: the experience aggregates carry no branch dimension; slicing an operational aggregate by branch × narrow window × small clinic is files/08 §0c F9's re-identification case, and adding one is a data-inventory decision under invariant 18 (stop-and-ask: Owner + compliance_officer; open in docs/evidence/INT-241.md, no HUMAN_BLOCKERS.md row minted)
csat.v1 / nps.v1 / clinician_pulse.v1 carry no voice-profile field; adding one is a data-inventory decision under invariant 18

filters.note: The mechanism ships and fails closed: the underlying events carry none of these dimensions, tenant scope is a token claim rather than a query parameter (files/08 §8 rule (a)), and the window is required with no default (invariant 20).

rows: both: the Talker holds the turn in memory and writes no lifecycle row, and sessions.started_at has no writer outside the test harness
the start: notes.created_at exists, but nothing transitions a session to COMPLETED, so sessions.completed_at is never written

the end: INT-150 landed the redemption route, and every open is written to the hash-chained audit log — which is EVIDENCE, not an analytics source, and is never mined for aggregates. No share-access row and no first_opened_at column exist. INT-307 built the unlabelled path this series needed, so the writer is no longer what is missing: landing a first-open instant on the share is, and no issue claims it
